profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Microsoft
profile.summary: Always willing to learn about innovative technologies and to acquire new knowledge and skills. Aiming to implement my skills in the creation of innovative projects. Always working on my technical skills, such as problem solving and analytical thinking, learning and improving through continuous work.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an internal low latency focused quota controller client, integrating with an internal rate limiter service, to prevent overwhelming of CDN customers’ servers from a high number of fetch requests.
• Integrated quota controller client with the current application responsible for fetching content from customers’ origin server.
• Implemented translation of customer configuration for request match conditions into Envoy proxy configuration and exposed it to customers to use.

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description:
The STEP Program is split into two project phases: an individual portfolio project and a group capstone project.
• Focused on creating accessible web content. Took an introductory course on web accessibility to learn how to do it.
• Implemented a portfolio using web technologies, which supported reading, creating, and translating comments for photos. Additional technologies include Google Datastore, Google Translation API, and Java Servlets.
• Built dynamic charts to visualize COVID-19 data in Mexico using the Google Charts API and Python.
• Developed a web app to connect street vendors with customers. The app allowed vendors to dynamically update their business information throughout the day and allowed customers to search for vendors nearby. Wrote design docs, participated in code reviews, and built automated test infrastructure.
• Collaborated with two interns in a virtual environment, effective communication allowed constant feedback.

honors.title: Recipient of Excellence Scholarship for Academic Merit
honors.description: Excellence scholarship is awarded to the best graduating high school students to undertake professional degree studies at Tecnológico de Monterrey.
honors.issuer: Issued by Tecnológico de Monterrey · Jan 2018

volunteerExperiences.description:
Volunteer at an educational organization (http://www.centroscomunitariosdeaprendizaje.org.mx/) providing free online courses about a variety of topics including languages, programming, and entrepreneurship.
• Replaced an outdated flash online course website with a modern one using HTML5, JavaScript and Bootstrap.
• Designed a responsive site with appealing elements and style to retain an estimate of 400,000 registered users.
• Developed visual elements, animations (e.g. progress bars) to make the site more interactive and intuitive to use for new and current users. 
• Expanded the site contents with new sections, such as quizzes, activities and games (e.g. memory game) using JavaScript to implement the logic.

projects.title: TwitterViz
projects.description:
A Twitter App to visualize how active a user is by plotting the frequency of Tweets, Replies and Retweets through time. Built with Python.
• Used the Twython library to access and interact with Twitter APIs.
• Built personalized data tables using Pandas by adding new columns and removing unnecessary data from Tweet objects.
• Examined the resulting data using Seaborn by drawing count plots (bar plots) and line plots, with results showing the peaks and gaps of use in different periods of time.

projects.title: Doodle Asteroid
projects.description:
A 2D space-shooter game made in Unity and developed in C#.
• Led a team of 4 programmers during the development of the game.
• Implemented the enemy AI with a player-following algorithm to chase the player through a 2D surface.
• Created a score system based on the number of enemies destroyed and the time the player survived.
• Programmed the player movement mechanics, spawn system of enemies and a script to adapt to different resolutions.
